national_news.title: Nation Pays Homage to Mahatma Gandhi and Lal Bahadur Shastri on Birth Anniversaries
bullets: The nation observed the 157th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi and the 122nd birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri on October 2, 2026.
President Droupadi Murmu, Vice President C P Radhakrishnan, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid floral tributes at Rajghat and Vijay Ghat in New Delhi.
Lal Bahadur Shastri was born on October 2, 1904, in Mughalsarai (now Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Nagar), Uttar Pradesh.

national_news.title: Ministry of Civil Aviation Initiates BCAS Reforms for Operational Efficiency
bullets: The Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA) through the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS) initiated reforms to simplify aviation security processes and enhance ease of doing business.
Security clearances have been made category and contract-agnostic, remaining valid for five years across nine identified aviation entities.
An end-to-end digital Aerodrome Entry Permit system featuring facial biometric verification is being implemented across 169 airports.
India is currently the world's third-largest domestic aviation market, with operational airports increasing from 74 in 2014 to 165 in July 2026.

national_news.title: Press Information Bureau Organises Swachhta Hi Seva 2026 Activities at National Media Centre
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) organized Swachhta Hi Seva 2026 activities at the National Media Centre (NMC), New Delhi, focusing on cleanliness, sanitation, and environmental sustainability.
A tree plantation drive was held under the 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' initiative on September 30, and a cleanliness drive under 'Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath' was conducted on October 1.
The events included a felicitation ceremony for Safai Mitras and sanitation workers to recognize their contribution to maintaining workplace hygiene.

national_news.title: Nationwide Cleanliness Drive Conducted Under Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Campaign
bullets: The 'Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath' cleanliness drive is being conducted nationwide as part of the Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Campaign.
The campaign runs from September 17 to October 17, with the theme 'Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat'.
Union Ministers participated in various Shramdaan activities across New Delhi, emphasizing waste management, river cleanliness, and water conservation.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Addresses Centenary Celebrations of UPSC
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Centenary Celebrations of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, marking 100 years since its establishment in 1926.
PM Modi released a UPSC Centenary Commemorative Coin, a Commemorative Stamp, and a book titled '100 Landmark Judgements – Shaping the Policies of UPSC and Public Service Commissions in India'.
During the NDA's 12-year tenure, approximately 65,000 appointments were made through the UPSC, with women currently constituting about 30% of successful candidates.

national_news.title: Government Reduces Sugar Stock Holding Period and Limit for Dealers to Prevent Hoarding
bullets: The Consumer Affairs Ministry reduced the stock holding period for sugar dealers to 15 days and fixed the limit at 1,000 quintals, effective from the 15th of the month till November.
Kolkata and its extended metropolitan areas and Assam have been granted a higher stock holding limit of 2,000 quintals due to logistical and geographical constraints.
The step aims to curb hoarding, ensure smooth festive supplies, and follows a 15% decline in average retail sugar prices from their August peak.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Emphasises Integrated Financial Systems for Defence Management
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the Defence Accounts Day in New Delhi, calling for synergy and integration within the financial framework of the Defence Accounts Department.
He noted that expenditure booking reached approximately 100 percent during the last financial year.

New IT initiatives were launched, including the integration of the Indian Army Financial Information System with the SAKSHAM platform, the revamped National Compilation System, and the PRISM platform.

national_news.title: Appointments Committee of the Cabinet Approves One-Year Re-employment of Dhirendra Ojha as PIB Principal DG
bullets: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) approved the re-employment of senior Indian Information Service (IIS) officer Dhirendra Ojha as Principal Director General of the Press Information Bureau (PIB).
The contract-based extension is for a period of one year effective from October 1, 2026, up to September 30, 2027, following his superannuation.
The ACC also approved the temporary upgradation of a Director General level post to Principal Director General level for senior officer Pragya Paliwal Gaur.

national_news.title: KVIC Chairman Highlights Success of Lijjat Papad and MSME Initiatives
bullets: KVIC Chairman Manoj Goyal addressed women artisans of Shri Mahila Griha Udyog Lijjat Papad in Mumbai, highlighting its contribution to 'Vocal for Local' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat'.
Lijjat Papad, established on March 15, 1959, with 7 women and Rs 80, was recognized as a Village Industry by KVIC in 1966 and currently employs over 45,000 women across 83 branches in 16 states.

Under KVIC and the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP), nearly 11 lakh new projects have been established with subsidies exceeding Rs 30,000 crore, generating employment for about 1 crore people.

national_news.title: PIB and CBC Jointly Undertake Swachhata Drive in Hyderabad
bullets: Press Information Bureau (PIB) and Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) participated in a nationwide Shramdaan drive at CGO Towers in Kavadiguda, Hyderabad.
The event was held under the Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 theme 'Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat'.
Activities included sapling plantation under 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' and distribution of protective kits to support staff and sanitation workers.

bihar_news.title: Rising Bihar Investor Summit 2026 Held in Patna
bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari addressed the Rising Bihar Investor Summit 2026 in Patna, themed 'The Emerging Investment Destination of India'.
The Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Package 2025 offers fiscal benefits, subsidies, and land concessions for eligible projects across over 100 industrial areas.
The state government has set an ambitious target of attracting investments worth Rs 5 lakh crore by November 2026.
